content.content: The file /Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/mc-design-eval/benchmarks/plugin-baseline/runs/build-1/sears-kit/crew/part-14/parts/room-7.mjs has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)

lines: // Room "P0 east bedroom" (interior designer's part): box x 11..12, y 6..8, z 14..20 (2 wide, 7 deep).
-// Two white beds: bed A's head on the partition at x 10 (z 14), bed B's head on the south wall (z 20).
-// The east wall is window (z 14..15, 19..20) and solid at z 16..18, so no bed can take the east wall without
-// blocking the door lane at z 16. The lane runs down x 11 from the doorway (10,6..7,16) to the south end.
-// Two barrels as the dresser on the east wall (z 16..17): a lantern stands on one, a potted flower on the other.
+// Intended furniture: two white beds (bed A foot x 12 z 14, head on the partition x 10; bed B foot x 12 z 19, head
+// on the south wall z 20), and a dresser of two barrels on the east wall (z 16..17) with a lantern and a potted poppy.
// Needs the partition x 10 solid except the doorway (see plan.md Notes): the beds' heads stand against it.
-import { layers, B } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
+// Not built: shell west (plots 0-3) sets every cell of this room to air, and runParts locks those cells, so each
+// write here was refused (air included). The furniture waits for the shell to leave the room's cells unclaimed.
-// bed() from the build library is not used: its air test (/(^|_)air$/) misses "minecraft:air", so it refuses every
-// cell and places nothing. This is the same contract with the test fixed: foot at [x,y,z], head one step toward facing.
-const STEP = { north: [0, -1], south: [0, 1], east: [1, 0], west: [-1, 0] };
-function bedAt(g, [x, y, z], facing, color) {
-  const [dx, dz] = STEP[facing];
-  const free = (x, y, z) => /(^|:)(cave_)?air$/.test(g.blockAt(x, y, z));
-  if (!free(x, y, z) || !free(x + dx, y, z + dz)) return false;
-  g.set(x, y, z, `${color}_bed`, { facing, part: "foot", occupied: "false" });
-  g.set(x + dx, y, z + dz, `${color}_bed`, { facing, part: "head", occupied: "false" });
-  return true;
export function build(g) {
-  // the beds: foot, then the head one step toward facing (the pillow end on a solid wall)
-  bedAt(g, [12, 6, 14], "west", "white");
-  bedAt(g, [12, 6, 19], "south", "white");
-  // dresser: two barrels (lids up) on the east wall at feet level y 6
-    b: ["barrel", { facing: "up", open: "false" }],
-  // a standing lantern on one barrel and a potted flower on the other (both on full top faces, y 7)
-    l: ["lantern", { hanging: "false", waterlogged: "false" }],
-    p: ["potted_poppy", {}],
return {};
